kpis.query: remaining_points = sum(jira.points) over issues where jira.status_category != 'Done'; trailing_throughput_per_day = (points reaching Done over last 14 sim-days, computed by diffing consecutive daily jira snapshots' status_category) / 14; forecast_ga = clock.sim_date + remaining_points / throughput; committed_ga = jira.due on the issue where jira.issue_type == 'Epic'; before 14 days of history use plan rate total_points/70; if throughput==0 report broken.
kpis.reason: All inputs are stored fields: points, status_category for done/remaining, epic due as committed GA, sim_date/sim_day for the clock, and the 14-day diff is served by daily snapshots. Reopen counter uses status_category diffs across snapshots.
kpis.caveat: Requires 14 sim-days of prior snapshots for the trailing throughput; on today's snapshot (sim_day 1) only one day of history exists, so throughput falls back to the plan rate total_points/70 and the forecast is plan-driven, not measured.

notes: Two rejected candidates in the tree name product outcomes with no source: trace coverage (% services emitting traces) and post-GA on-call alert volume — the catalog has no telemetry or alerting feed, confirming the unmeasurable ground; the successor program would need a traces feed and an alerting/on-call source collected.

Both cost KPIs depend entirely on the spend source, which is 'missing' on the day-1 sample (spend_rows=0); every cost verdict will render broken until the first Monday-after row lands. This is the expected staleness case the tree's failure_modes already call out.

The forecast, scope, slack, and blocked-share KPIs all rely on snapshot-to-snapshot diffing (throughput over 14 days, presence vs day-0, reopen counter); confirmation assumes prior daily snapshots are retained and readable, not just today's — worth an explicit check in the measure harness.
Jira changelog, comments, worklogs, and sprint fields are not available; every Jira KPI here correctly uses snapshot state or snapshot diffs rather than transition history, so none are affected.
